title: Keep the primary-checkout watcher alive, and surface the board checks at every sync
goal: Two gaps from the verification. (1) The watcher is required while agents run (Mandate 49) and dies with whatever session started it; nothing restarts it, so the primary checkout quietly stopped converging for five hours and only the check noticed. Make the loop boundaries heal it: a shared ensure-watcher.sh that decides from the heartbeat stamp and restarts it when stale, called from sync (and therefore from finish). (2) The board checkers only run when someone remembers: wire a compact, non-fatal board summary (hygiene, swarm readiness, roadmap queue) into sync, so they run continuously at the boundary every agent already crosses. Both must be cheap, timeout-bounded and never block the loop.
